The P5 registry has a retro-doctor-cli row (cite [18], VERBS contract), but CHUPA_PLAN.md has no '### 19.P5.retro-doctor-cli' heading. The P5 entry units stop at 19.P5.baseline-binding-reader. So entry_unit_gap(plan, '19.P5.retro-doctor-cli') returns 'entry unit 19.P5.retro-doctor-cli is missing'. The successor's Plan contract also cannot cite that unit, because the grammar gate refuses unresolvable ids.
